description: This file defines socket classes (ClientSocket and ServerSocket) for TCP communication, including methods for sending and receiving data, and functions for appending data in network byte order. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and includes utility functions for message creation.

classes.name: ClientSocket
classes.description: A class for managing TCP client socket connections, supporting sending and receiving messages, with thread safety considerations.

classes.name: ServerSocket
classes.description: A class for managing TCP server socket, accepting incoming client connections.

methods.name: Recv
methods.description: Receives a specified amount of data from the socket.

methods.name: RecvAny
methods.description: Receives any available data from the socket.

methods.name: SendNoSignal
methods.description: Sends data over the socket with MSG_NOSIGNAL to prevent SIGPIPE.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection on the server socket.

methods.name: CreateMessage
methods.description: Creates a message by appending multiple values in network byte order.
